_note: People who sat in your seat before you. Dealt into the party as themselves (see Heroes.from_victim). Their traits carry min_level 99 so level-up never offers them to anyone else.

victims.name: Steve
victims.story: Rolled eleven ones in a row and laughed at every one. On the twelfth the Caller stopped laughing with him.
victims.quirk: blows on the die, then apologises to it

victims.name: Janet
victims.story: Kept a second die in her cardigan sleeve. He found it. He found the sleeve too.
victims.quirk: never lets anyone see her hands

victims.name: Linda
victims.story: Did not get up for the interval. Did not get up when the lights went. She is still in the chair, under the dust sheet.
victims.quirk: keeps her handbag on her lap the whole night

victims.name: Dave
victims.story: Said fireball was a perfectly reasonable answer to everything. The candle on table four agreed with him.
victims.quirk: smells of singed hair and doesn't seem to notice

victims.name: Sandra
victims.story: Paid for everyone's healing out of her own veins. The Caller let her run a tab. The tab came due.
victims.quirk: picks at a scab on her wrist when she thinks

victims.name: Gary
victims.story: Lost on a natural one and put the table through the window. The Caller set it back up. Gary went where the table had been.
victims.quirk: grips the edge of the table with both hands

victims.name: Kevin
victims.story: Nobody noticed he had stopped rolling. It was three rounds before anyone asked. He had been dead for four.
victims.quirk: is easy to forget, even while he's talking

victims.name: Trevor
victims.story: Copied the Caller's notes when he looked away. Learned everything the monsters could do. Learned what the Caller does, too.

victims.name: Colin
victims.story: Came in for one. Ordered another every round. On the ninth round the Caller poured it himself.
victims.quirk: taps the glass twice before every roll

victims.name: Marjorie
victims.story: Outlived three husbands and the rest of her party. Sang at every funeral. The Caller asked her to sing at her own.
victims.quirk: wears black to every session, just in case

victims.name: Pauline
victims.story: Needed one number for a full house. Sat with her dauber raised for nineteen years. It was never called.
victims.quirk: dabs the table whenever anyone says a number

victims.name: Brenda
victims.story: Said she had to get home to the kids, put her coat on and walked to the door. The door was on the board.
victims.quirk: keeps her coat on and her car keys in her hand

victims.name: Derek
victims.story: Argued a ruling for forty minutes with the rulebook open at page 41. The Caller let him finish. Then he tore out page 41.
victims.quirk: has a bookmark in every rulebook ever printed

victims.name: Maureen
victims.story: Kept a list of everyone who ever wronged her. The Caller was on it, near the top. Then she was on his.
victims.quirk: remembers your name, and what you did

abilities.name: One More Go
abilities.desc: Attack an adjacent enemy for 1d8 + Might. If it misses, you gain 1 Empowered (+3 damage, stacks to 3, 2 turns) and 1 Grit.

abilities.name: Loaded Die
abilities.desc: The next d20 any hero rolls shows at least 15. Adds 10 to his FILE on you, even if he isn't looking.

abilities.name: Saved You a Seat
abilities.desc: Pull an ally within 5 up to 4 tiles towards you. They are guarded (+3 defense) until their next turn.

abilities.name: Backdraft
abilities.desc: Spend 2 Mana: everyone next to you, friend or foe, makes a Grace save: 2d8 fire (half on a save) and burning. The floor around you and under you catches fire.

abilities.name: Tithe
abilities.desc: Pay 5 of your own HP, no Faith: an ally within 4 heals 2d8 + Nerve and loses one debuff. Lifts the downed. Cannot be used if it would kill you.

abilities.name: Flip the Table
abilities.desc: Once per fight. Everyone within 2, friend or foe, makes a Grace save: 2d8 + Might (half on a save); on a failure they are shoved 2 and dazed. 4 piles of rubble land at random on the board. You gain 2 Rage, and attacks against you have advantage until your next turn.

abilities.name: Nobody Noticed
abilities.desc: Only with no enemy next to you: become hidden again for 2 turns and gain 2 movement.

abilities.name: Crib Notes
abilities.desc: Spend 2 Mana: an enemy within 6 takes 1d6 psychic, and you copy one of its cards you don't already have, chosen at random. You keep it until the fight ends.

abilities.name: Last Orders
abilities.desc: Once per fight: take another action this turn. You are dazed (disadvantage on your d20 rolls) for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Eulogy
abilities.desc: Spend 2 Verse: enemies within 2 make a Nerve save: 2d6 psychic (half on a save), and on a failure they are frightened of you for a turn.

abilities.name: Full House
abilities.desc: Spend 3 Pact, once per fight: every enemy in a 5x5 area takes 1d6 psychic, and every hexed one takes 3d8 more. No save.

abilities.name: Excuse Me
abilities.desc: Swap places with any single-tile unit within 4, friend or foe. Afterwards, moving away provokes nothing this turn.

abilities.name: Actually, Page 41
abilities.desc: For 2 rounds every enemy d20 that shows 1-4 is a fumble and fails. The Caller corrects you: you take 4 psychic damage.

abilities.name: I Remember You
abilities.desc: 1d10 + Might. Against a hunted enemy, 2d6 more.

traits.name: Snake Eyes
traits.desc: You never reroll natural 1s, and you fumble on a 1 or 2. Whenever anyone else's d20 shows a natural 1, you gain 1 Empowered (+3 damage, stacks to 3, 2 turns).

traits.name: Card Up Her Sleeve
traits.desc: While his FILE on you is 35 or more: +2 to attack rolls and +2 damage, but attacks against you also get +2.

traits.name: Never Left Her Seat
traits.desc: Your speed is always 0 and you cannot be shoved. +2 defense. At the start of your turn, adjacent allies heal 2.

traits.name: Singed
traits.desc: You resist fire (half damage). Your fire damage deals +2.

traits.name: Running a Tab
traits.desc: Whenever you pay HP, you regenerate 3 HP at the start of your next 2 turns. The first time you are hurt each turn, gain 1 Faith.

traits.name: Sore Loser
traits.desc: -1 defense. Below half HP: +2 damage and +1 speed.

traits.name: Unremarkable
traits.desc: Start every fight hidden, and stay hidden until you attack or take damage. Once a turn, a hit while hidden deals 2d6 more.

traits.name: Takes Notes
traits.desc: Whenever an enemy misses you, gain 1 Mana.

traits.name: Dutch Courage
traits.desc: -1 to attack rolls. Every time the party ends its turn with a sip, you gain 1d6 + 2 temporary HP.

traits.name: Wears Black
traits.desc: Whenever another hero goes down, gain 1 Empowered (+3 damage) for the rest of the fight and 2 Verse. Whenever another hero dies, gain 2 Empowered and 2d6 temporary HP. Empowered stacks to 3.

traits.name: Eyes Down
traits.desc: Statuses you apply last 1 turn longer. Whenever you kill a hexed enemy, gain 2 Pact.

traits.name: Coat On
traits.desc: +1 speed. The first time you move each turn, you are guarded (+3 defense) until your next turn.

traits.name: Rules Lawyer
traits.desc: +2 to saving throws, and you cannot be dazed or confused. The Caller dislikes you: attacks against you get +1.

traits.name: Grudge
traits.desc: -1 defense. Any enemy that hurts you is hunted for 2 turns: +1 to hit it and +3 damage from every hit.
